description: After one minutes the 8 o'clock bell sounds in the tower. It's a beautiful, low tone, as it belongs to a stately Sint Jan (Saint John) cathedral in ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Wood pigeons flutter through the branches of the tall trees. In the distance, the baker loads his car full of crates of bread and talks with his colleague. A moped rider goes to work. It is still very quiet in the city on this spring Saturday. Date/time: April 29th Saturday 2017, 7.59 am Weather: 3c, clear sky, wind SW 2bft, 1018 hPa. Mic pointed SW Location; Sint Janskerkhof 19, ‘s-Hertogenbosch (Den Bosch), Noord-Brabant, Netherlands (Holland), Europe.
